description: This Java interface defines a contract for consuming message responses, encapsulating a bi-consumer that handles successful Message objects or Throwables indicating errors. It also provides a method to retrieve the expected response type. It is marked as deprecated since version 1.2.0.

classes.name: MessageResponseConsumer
classes.description: A functional interface encapsulating a BiConsumer that handles message responses with either a successful Message or a Throwable error. It also provides the expected response type.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the type of response expected from the message.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns the BiConsumer that will be notified about the message response, which can be either a Message or a Throwable.
